# sendgrid_address_whitelist_mail_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide address whitelist mail setting: mail sent to addresses or domains on this list bypasses spam filtering. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one address whitelist configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_address_whitelist_mail_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
  list    = ["example.com", "trusted-sender@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the address whitelist mail setting is enabled.

### Optional

- `list` (Set of String) Email addresses and/or domains to whitelist. All email addresses belonging to a whitelisted domain bypass spam filtering.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `address_whitelist_mail_settings`.
